sources: Microsoft Learn: Standardized INF keywords for power management, *EEE ("Energy-efficient ethernet", IEEE 802.3az): 0 = Disabled, 1 = Enabled (default).

Set like Set-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty through MSFT_NetAdapterAdvancedPropertySettingData (root\StandardCimv2). Only adapters whose driver offers the property; without such an adapter the tweak is not available. Checked read-only on the development PC (Realtek 2.5GbE, value 0).
